item.title: Beyond NASA: A Look at the AI Inside China’s Zhurong Mars Rover
item.description: While global attention is often monopolized by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and its Curiosity-class vehicles, Chinese space engineering reached a critical milestone with the Tianwen-1 mission. Landing in May 2021 on the vast plains of Utopia Planitia, the Zhurong rover represents more than just a political success; it is a tangible demonstration of advanced autonomous robotics. AI Inside China's Zhurong
